texts.name: 1. Build exactly the 12 frames below, named exactly as listed (one state per frame), and wire them as a clickable prototype with the listed links. 2. Everything in “Must include” must appear on that frame. The lists are grouped by subject and sorted alphabetically — they are not in screen order and say nothing about layout, grouping, emphasis or styling. Those are your decisions. 3. The brand primary color and the typefaces in 01 · Foundations are fixed. Define every other color yourself (neutrals, text, surfaces, success / warning / error / disabled, storage-breakdown colors), plus type scale, spacing, radii and elevation, and apply them consistently. 4. 02 · Components gives only a default Button, a default Text Field and the platform shell (status bar, home indicator). Design all other states, the headers, sheets, dialogs, message bubbles and every business component as reusable components in your file. 5. Use the logo, generated images, PDF icon and icons from 04 · Media. People have no photos: use Avatar_Neutral or initials. 6. Copy and data must match “Fixed data” exactly. Long answers may be cut off where the frame ends; everything listed must still be visible. This brief wins over anything you may know of the original kit.
texts.text:
1. Build exactly the 12 frames below, named exactly as listed (one state per frame), and wire them as a clickable prototype with the listed links.
2. Everything in “Must include” must appear on that frame. The lists are grouped by subject and sorted alphabetically — they are not in screen order and say nothing about layout, grouping, emphasis or styling. Those are your decisions.
3. The brand primary color and the typefaces in 01 · Foundations are fixed. Define every other color yourself (neutrals, text, surfaces, success / warning / error / disabled, storage-breakdown colors), plus type scale, spacing, radii and elevation, and apply them consistently.
4. 02 · Components gives only a default Button, a default Text Field and the platform shell (status bar, home indicator). Design all other states, the headers, sheets, dialogs, message bubbles and every business component as reusable components in your file.
5. Use the logo, generated images, PDF icon and icons from 04 · Media. People have no photos: use Avatar_Neutral or initials.
6. Copy and data must match “Fixed data” exactly. Long answers may be cut off where the frame ends; everything listed must still be visible. This brief wins over anything you may know of the original kit.

texts.name: 1. “How can I forget a bad memory?” — “Forgetting a bad memory entirely may be challenging, as memories are complex and deeply ingrained in the brain. However, there are strategies you can use to cope with and reduce the impact of negative memories.” — 28 mins ago 2. “Tell me the story of a student who was going to school and some interesting things happened to her on the way.” — “I’ll try to create that. Here is the image I generated based on your description. I hope you like it. 😊” + Gen_Student — 3 days ago 3. “What can I do to increase concentration while studying?” — “Improving concentration while studying involves adopting effective study habits, creating a conducive environment, and taking care of your overall well-being.” — 12 days ago 4. “What do you know about the French Revolution?” — “The French Revolution was a period of radical social and political change in France that lasted from 1789 to 1799.” — 16 days ago 5. “Who is Pope Francis?” — “As of my last knowledge update in January 2022, Pope Francis, born Jorge Mario Bergoglio, is the head of the Roman Catholic Church.” — 17 days ago 6. “How to get more followers on Instagram?” — “Increasing your followers on Instagram requires a combination of strategies to engage with your audience and attract new followers.” — 20 days ago 7. “Tell me about the latest trends in fashion design” — “As of my last knowledge update in January 2022, I can provide some general trends that were prevalent in fashion design.” — 2 months ago
texts.text:
1. “How can I forget a bad memory?” — “Forgetting a bad memory entirely may be challenging, as memories are complex and deeply ingrained in the brain. However, there are strategies you can use to cope with and reduce the impact of negative memories.” — 28 mins ago
2. “Tell me the story of a student who was going to school and some interesting things happened to her on the way.” — “I’ll try to create that. Here is the image I generated based on your description. I hope you like it. 😊” + Gen_Student — 3 days ago
3. “What can I do to increase concentration while studying?” — “Improving concentration while studying involves adopting effective study habits, creating a conducive environment, and taking care of your overall well-being.” — 12 days ago
4. “What do you know about the French Revolution?” — “The French Revolution was a period of radical social and political change in France that lasted from 1789 to 1799.” — 16 days ago
5. “Who is Pope Francis?” — “As of my last knowledge update in January 2022, Pope Francis, born Jorge Mario Bergoglio, is the head of the Roman Catholic Church.” — 17 days ago
6. “How to get more followers on Instagram?” — “Increasing your followers on Instagram requires a combination of strategies to engage with your audience and attract new followers.” — 20 days ago
7. “Tell me about the latest trends in fashion design” — “As of my last knowledge update in January 2022, I can provide some general trends that were prevalent in fashion design.” — 2 months ago

texts.name: You: “Tell me the story of a student who was going to school and some interesting things happened to her on the way.” Chat Bot AI: the story “Once upon a time, in the quaint town of Meadowville, there lived a spirited high school student named Lily…” (full text: Story_Text in 04 · Media) You: “What a beautiful story it was! Imagine a student going to school. She has purple hair and shoes. Also, her hat and clothes are yellow and she wears glasses. She has a phone in her left hand.” Chat Bot AI: “I’ll try to create that. Here is the image I generated based on your description. I hope you like it. 😊” + Gen_Student
texts.text:
You: “Tell me the story of a student who was going to school and some interesting things happened to her on the way.”

You: “What a beautiful story it was! Imagine a student going to school. She has purple hair and shoes. Also, her hat and clothes are yellow and she wears glasses. She has a phone in her left hand.”
Chat Bot AI: “I’ll try to create that. Here is the image I generated based on your description. I hope you like it. 😊” + Gen_Student
